mapper.select: SELECT MAX(SEQ) FROM LIVE_START_END GROUP BY PGM_ID HAVING PGM_ID = #{pgmId}

SELECT LSE.ID, LSE.START_DATE, LSE.PGM_ID, LSE.GOODS_ID, LSE.END_DATE, LSE.SEQ, G.GOODS_NM, P.PGM_NM FROM LIVE_START_END LSE INNER JOIN GOODS G ON LSE.GOODS_ID = G.ID INNER JOIN PROGRAM P ON LSE.PGM_ID = P.ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND PGM_ID = #{pgmId}
SELECT count(*) FROM LIVE_START_END WHERE END_DATE IS NULL

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ID, PGM_ID, GOODS_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SEQ ORDER BY GOODS_ID) AS RNK, START_DATE, END_DATE FROM LIVE_START_END WHERE PGM_ID = #{pgmId}) MST_GOODS WHERE 1 = 1 AND MST_GOODS.RNK = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM faq_sumr_info fsi WHERE fsi.live_start_end_id = mst_goods.id )
SELECT PGM_ID FROM LIVE_START_END WHERE END_DATE IS NULL LIMIT 1
